info.title: AbiZeitBetrug Portal API
info.description: Private LMGU 2027 editorial portal. External OIDC login establishes a server-side cookie session; JWTs stay on the backend. CSRF-protected mutations and all authorization enforced server-side. Authentication redirects and provider endpoints are outside this API.

get.summary: List collections (students: no drafts; ballot_count and participation editors only)

post.summary: Create collection of any kind (admins and managers; manager creator receives a category grant atomically)

patch.summary: Update collection (admin or granted manager); ballot definitions lock after first opening, bounded poll deadlines remain editable with version and closes_at only; repeatable and ongoing fixed after creation; photo collections with active images cannot change to a non-photo kind

delete.summary: Delete a single-answer collection and its votes/history (admin only; 400 repeatable, 404 missing, 409 stale version)

post.summary: Create idempotent contribution; multipart images only for photo collections and create atomically

patch.summary: Edit own pending contribution with optimistic concurrency; active images cannot move to a non-photo collection; editorial roles cannot change another author’s original

post.summary: Attach image to own pending contribution in a photo collection only; other collection types return 400

delete.summary: Remove attachment from own pending contribution; final image in a photo collection cannot be removed

patch.summary: Edit photo caption on own pending contribution with optimistic concurrency

post.summary: Add editorial annotation with category grant (any status), or author correction request on locked contribution

get.summary: Export all collected contributions by default, with optional explicit status filter (editors, repeatable only)

parameters.name: status
parameters.description: Defaults to all statuses; explicit status filtering remains available for later moderation.

post.summary: Open, close or hide a collection (admin or manager with grant; draft->open, open->closed, open/closed->draft). Expired collections cannot reopen. Hiding preserves votes/history and first opened_at; reopening keeps candidates fixed.

put.summary: Cast a named ballot: replace current selection when one-off; append an idempotent entry when repeatable (ballot_id required)

ballot_id.description: Client-generated key required for repeatable ballots; replay with the same selection returns success without an extra entry, changed selection conflicts.

items.description: One Unicode NFC lowercase word without whitespace or control characters; normalized on input.

get.summary: Editorial anonymous original word counts and moderation, word portraits only

patch.summary: Grant-controlled reversible word exclusion/correction/merge; originals and named history stay unchanged

get.summary: Editorial CSV export of included effective words and distinct voter counts, word portraits only

200.description: CSV with formula-safe word and count columns

ongoing.description: No scheduled closing when true (default); false requires a future closes_at. Stored independently of content kind and repeatability.

closes_at.description: Automatic closing instant for bounded collections; null when ongoing. Open collections are effectively closed at this instant.

repeatable.description: Allow multiple contributions or independent ballot entries per person, independently of kind. False ballots retain one changeable current selection.

status.description: All kinds support draft, open and closed; the closing deadline also makes open collections effectively closed. Draft means hidden from students, including previously opened polls; opened_at distinguishes editable new drafts from locked hidden polls.

options.description: Empty for contribution kinds, word portraits, and all_people person poll input; otherwise explicit voting options. Word portrait responses never expose other voters’ words.

my_option_id.description: First current selection in canonical ID order (legacy compatibility), or null.

opened_at.description: Set once when a single-answer category moves from draft to open; creation time for repeatable ones.

ballot_count.description: Number of distinct current voters. Editors only; null for students and contribution categories.

participation.description: Current voting participation among admitted cohort members, regardless of role. Both counts use the same population and database snapshot. Editors only; null for students and contribution categories. Preserved ballots from people no longer eligible are excluded here but remain in ballot_count.

voted.description: Currently eligible people with a current ballot in this collection.

all_people.description: Person polls only: all admitted cohort members, refreshed when opening and fixed thereafter. Existing polls retain explicit candidates.

max_choices.description: Maximum selections for person/proposal polls or words per voter for word portraits (1–500). Word portraits default to 3, other polls to 1; contribution kinds require 1.

my_option_ids.description: Viewer’s complete current selection; empty for contribution categories or before voting.

my_words.description: Only the viewer’s current original normalized words, empty for other kinds or before voting. Originals are unchanged by editorial moderation.

ballot_id.description: Groups the complete selection from one ballot change. Null for legacy single-choice history.

ongoing.description: No scheduled closing when true (default); false requires a future closes_at. Stored independently of content kind and repeatability.

closes_at.description: Automatic closing instant for bounded collections; null when ongoing. Open collections are effectively closed at this instant.

repeatable.description: Allow multiple contributions per person independently of kind. Omission defaults from kind on create and preserves the stored flag on edit.

options.description: Empty for contribution kinds, word portraits, and all_people person poll input; otherwise explicit voting options. Word portrait responses never expose other voters’ words.

all_people.description: Person polls: all admitted cohort members instead of explicit options. Defaults true on creation; omission preserves mode on edit. Other kinds require false.

max_choices.description: Maximum selections for person/proposal polls or words per voter for word portraits (1–500). Word portraits default to 3, other polls to 1; contribution kinds require 1.

ongoing.description: No scheduled closing when true (default); false requires a future closes_at. Stored independently of content kind and repeatability.

closes_at.description: Future closing instant. For existing bounded polls, a sparse request containing only version and closes_at changes the deadline in any lifecycle state without changing definitions, votes, history or stored status. Omitted deadlines are preserved exactly; contribution deadlines remain fixed. Extending an expired stored-open poll makes it open again; manually closed or hidden polls stay closed or hidden.
